integrity: The all-order result is proved by an exhaustive structural analysis of when a first cross-side vertex can footprint a new vertex. Finite computation is used only as a stress test. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to crown graphs \(\operatorname{Cr}_n\) with \(n\ge5\); smaller orders have additional exceptional maximum-set types.
The exhaustive verifier covers \(5\le n\le7\); the all-order statement is proved symbolically.
The originality comparison cannot exclude an unindexed or differently phrased source that separately enumerates the same crown-graph extremizers.
title: Maximum Grundy dominating sequences of crown graphs
